lesson.subject: science
lesson.title: Healthy Me
lesson.summary: How food, exercise, sleep and washing keep our bodies healthy.
learning_objectives: Name types of food and how much to eat
Explain why we need exercise and sleep
Wash hands properly and keep clean

standards.text: Describe the importance for humans of exercise, eating the right amounts of different types of food, and hygiene

success_criteria: I can name the four food groups
I know why exercise and sleep matter
I can wash my hands properly
lesson.real_life: Packing a school lunch with daal, roti and fruit chaat, and washing hands before meals.

warm_up.prompt: What do we use to wash our hands?

blocks.markdown: Today's big question: how do we stay healthy?
blocks.say: Today we find out how to stay healthy. What helps our bodies grow strong?

blocks.alt: Red apples, strawberries, tomatoes, peppers and raspberries arranged around a white space
blocks.caption: Red fruit and vegetables. A healthy plate has many colours.
blocks.credit: Photo by Jakub Kapusnak on Unsplash
blocks.say: Look at all these colours. Fruit and vegetables are part of a healthy diet.

blocks.markdown: A **diet** is all the food we eat.
blocks.say: Food comes in groups. Each group does a different job for our bodies.

scenes.caption: Fruit and veg.
scenes.say: Fruit and vegetables give us vitamins. They keep us healthy.

scenes.caption: Starchy food.
scenes.say: Bread, rice and roti give us energy to run and play.

scenes.caption: Protein.
scenes.say: Meat, fish, eggs and daal are protein. Protein helps us grow.

scenes.caption: Dairy.
scenes.say: Milk, yoghurt and cheese are dairy. They help make strong bones.

question.prompt: Which food group gives us energy to run and play?
question.explanation: Bread, rice and roti give us energy.

blocks.markdown: **Treats** are for sometimes, not every day.
blocks.say: Sweets, crisps and fizzy drinks are treats. We eat them only sometimes.

blocks.markdown: Water keeps our bodies working well.
blocks.say: Water is the best drink. We drink some all through the day.

scenes.caption: Healthy.
scenes.say: Zainab eats fruit chaat after school. That is a healthy snack.

scenes.caption: A treat.
scenes.say: On Eid she enjoys a sweet treat. That is fine as a treat.

scenes.caption: Drinks.
scenes.say: Every day she drinks water or milk, not fizzy drinks.

question.prompt: Sweets are a treat to enjoy only sometimes.
question.hint: Can we eat sweets all day?
question.explanation: Sweets are for sometimes, not every day.

blocks.title: Zainab fights the germs
blocks.transcript: Zainab wants to stay healthy. She has a plan for each day. At lunch she eats a rainbow plate. It has fruit, roti and daal. She drinks water. Fizzy drinks are not for every day. After school she runs in the park. Her heart beats faster. Tiny germs sit on the door handle. Zainab cannot see them. She washes her hands with soap and water. The germs wash away! At night she brushes her teeth. Then she goes to sleep. Sleep helps her grow. Alhamdulillah, she feels well and strong!
blocks.caption: Zainab uses soap bubbles and a rainbow plate to stay healthy.

points: Food has four groups: fruit and veg, starchy food, protein, dairy
Each group does a job for our bodies
Sweets and fizzy drinks are treats
blocks.say: Let us remember. Eat from all the food groups. Treats are for sometimes.

Things in food that keep our bodies healthy.
Food that helps us grow, such as fish, eggs and daal.

blocks.say: We do not eat the same amount of every food. We eat more of some.

scenes.caption: Biggest.
scenes.say: Half the plate is fruit and vegetables. These are the biggest part.

scenes.caption: Medium.
scenes.say: A quarter is starchy food, like rice or roti. A quarter is protein.

scenes.caption: Tiny.
scenes.say: Sweets, crisps and fats are only a tiny part, if any.

question.prompt: Which should be the biggest part of a healthy plate?
question.explanation: Fruit and vegetables should fill the biggest part.

question.explanation: A good lunch has food from each group.

points: Eat lots of fruit and vegetables

blocks.say: Exercise means moving our bodies. Running, skipping and cricket are all exercise.

scenes.caption: Running.
scenes.say: Zainab runs across the field. Her legs and arms work hard.

scenes.caption: A fast heart.
scenes.say: Her heart beats faster. It pumps blood to her muscles.

scenes.caption: Strong.
scenes.say: Exercise makes the heart and muscles stronger. It helps us feel happy too.

question.prompt: What happens to our heart when we run?
question.explanation: The heart beats faster to pump blood to our muscles.

blocks.say: Our bodies need rest. Sleep helps us grow and stay well.
Play a memory game to warm up your brain. Then answer a question.

blocks.title: Healthy day
blocks.goal: Watch the order, then copy it. It gets longer each time!
blocks.say: Watch the pictures light up, then copy them.

question.prompt: Pick two things that help us stay healthy.
question.explanation: Sleep and exercise both help us stay healthy.

points: Exercise makes our heart and muscles strong
Our heart beats faster when we run
Sleep helps us grow and learn
blocks.say: Let us remember. Exercise makes our heart strong. Sleep helps us grow.

terms.meaning: Moving your body to keep it strong.

blocks.markdown: **Germs** can make us ill. We cannot see them.
blocks.say: Germs are tiny living things. They are too small for us to see.

blocks.markdown: Soap and water wash germs away.
blocks.say: Germs spread from hands to food and faces. Washing hands stops them spreading.

blocks.alt: Hands covered in soap suds being washed under a running tap in a sink
blocks.caption: Soap and running water wash germs away.
blocks.credit: Photo by Mélissa Jeanty on Unsplash
blocks.say: Soap lifts dirt and germs off our skin. Water rinses them away.

scenes.caption: Wet.
scenes.say: First, wet your hands under running water.

scenes.caption: Soap.
scenes.say: Rub soap on the front, back, thumbs and between your fingers.

scenes.caption: Scrub.
scenes.say: Scrub for about twenty seconds. Sing a short song to count.

scenes.caption: Rinse and dry.
scenes.say: Rinse off the soap. Dry with a clean towel.

question.prompt: Put the hand-washing steps in order.

blocks.markdown: Cover coughs and sneezes with your elbow.
blocks.say: We wash our hands before eating and after the toilet. We cough into our elbow.

blocks.alt: An orange toothbrush with a line of green toothpaste on a yellow background
blocks.caption: Brushing twice a day keeps teeth clean.
blocks.credit: Photo by Tosan Dudun on Unsplash
blocks.say: We brush our teeth twice a day. Muslims also wash hands and face for wudu.
Clean habits keep us healthy and keep others healthy too.

scenes.caption: Lunch.
scenes.say: Zainab washes her hands before lunch every day.

scenes.caption: Elbow.
scenes.say: She sneezes into her elbow, not into her hands.

scenes.caption: Teeth.
scenes.say: At night she brushes her teeth. They stay clean and strong.
